evidence.claim: Job openings and corporate outlines from DMT Petrologic indicate that their Team Leader for Seismic Data Processing explicitly holds the responsibility for the "resource management of CPU, disk, and personnel to ensure on-time delivery of products" across 2D/3D land and marine imaging projects.

evidence.claim: In 2017, Tower Resources awarded DMT Petrologic a dedicated contract to merge and reprocess 3D marine seismic data covering approximately 500 km² over the shallow-water Thali license in the Rio del Rey basin offshore Cameroon.

evidence.claim: ADX Energy contracted DMT to reprocess and optimize the Iecea Mare 3D seismic dataset to improve structural imaging prior to their Parta 3D exploration program.
